purpose: Record authenticated 2026-08-19 provider readback attempts without promoting stale migration, schema, security, or Edge Function evidence to current production truth.

canonical_context.interpretation: Authenticated provider evidence governs current reality; the stale canonical context remains historical evidence.

read_attempts.interpretation: The denial is not evidence that the project is absent.
No current migration count or ledger was established.
An empty connector scope is not evidence that the target project is absent.
Postgres version, database identity, and live object state were not read.
The upstream account list was returned but rejected before an account could be selected. Worker 2 preserved the boundary and did not create a competing connector fix.
Plan payload arguments could not be used to recover the non-secret account mapping.

coupled_runtime_readback.interpretation: READY preview evidence proves only a preview build for the exact source SHA. It is not a production deployment or Supabase parity proof.

fail_closed_invariants: Authorization denial is never interpreted as an empty production project.
The 2026-08-17 migration count is never represented as current on 2026-08-19.
Historical Edge Function versions are never represented as current without provider readback.
No migration SQL is invented to close a provenance gap.
No production migration, schema object, data row, Edge Function, or deployment was mutated.
No billable Supabase branch was created.
No secret value was read into or persisted by this artifact.

requirements: select the configured Supabase account without connector schema loss
read project identity, region, Postgres version, and exposed schemas
inventory schema objects, RLS, policies, grants, SECURITY DEFINER routines, triggers, event triggers, and scheduled jobs
list every relevant Edge Function and fetch exact live source
capture provider and canonical hashes without secret values
next_required_capture.gate: Only a successful authenticated capture may replace null current_live_state fields and advance production_verified.
